pages.title: Slotted Book
pages.text: Right-click in hand to open the book. Store one item stack inside and write a title and up to five lines of description. Click Save to keep the text. A slotted book cannot store another slotted book.
Use it to pair a labeled sample with notes about where it came from.

pages.title: Redstone Book
pages.text: Right-click in hand to edit its title. Put it in a BiblioCraft bookcase to emit the slot index as signal strength, from 0 to 15. The first redstone book in slot order sets the strength. The opening stays unpowered.
A Redstone: Volume I book works under its original or custom title.
